# hiok_yugabyte_cluster (Resource)

A managed YugabyteDB cluster — distributed SQL over the PostgreSQL wire protocol. One node per region; replication factor follows the count and is kept odd.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String)

### Optional

- `admin_password` (String, Sensitive) Default: generated.
- `admin_username` (String)
- `database_name` (String)
- `engine_version` (String)
- `ram_gb` (Number) RAM per node.
- `region` (String)
- `regions` (List of String) One node per region. Three regions give RF 3; two give RF 1, because a majority needs an odd number.
- `resource_group_id` (String) Resource group the resource is placed in.
- `sku` (String)
- `storage_gb` (Number)
- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription the resource is billed to.
- `v_cpu` (Number) vCPUs per node.
- `vnet_address` (String) Address space when creating a network.
- `vnet_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `admin_ui_url` (String)
- `host` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `replication_factor` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `status_message` (String)
- `ycql_port` (Number)
- `ysql_port` (Number)
